record.name: Force Transcendence
record.narrative: You impose multiple upon your target, forcing them to suffer experience multiple.

manifestation.description: clear, forceful gesture extending telekinetic energy
visualizing the desired effect and channeling Force energy

base_effect.description: You transcend existence itself, becoming a being beyond time, space, and reality - the ultimate expression of Force mastery.

mechanics.notes: Become a transcendent being beyond mortal comprehension
Become one with the Force itself, existing in all places and times simultaneously
Cannot be killed, destroyed, or affected by any force in existence

class_synergies.narrative: Guardian approaches Force Transcendence through the lens of protection, finding unexpected harmony in the manipulating the Force to achieve the impossible. Their defensive combat and protection of others guides them to vibrating air with a focused resolve that reflects their unique perspective.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Guardians gain +4 to Force power attack rolls.

species_synergies.narrative: Human adaptability allows them to quickly master new powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Humans gain advantage on power learning checks.

faction_synergies.narrative: The Jedi Order teaches the proper use of Force powers.

mechanical_benefit.notes: Jedi gain +2 to Force power saving throw DCs.

llm_guidance.roleplay_guidance: Describe the transcendent_being effect taking hold. Focus on how the power's effects manifest physically and mechanically, emphasizing apply multiple status effects.
llm_guidance.tactical_notes: Force Transcendence is excellent for applying multiple effects to control groups of enemies. Use it at 0 multiverse range. The effects last 1 round.
narrative_hooks: Force Transcendence forces a target to suffer multiple, changing the course of the encounter
The multiple effect of Force Transcendence creates an opportunity that would otherwise not exist

image_generation.base_prompt: A dramatic digital painting of. Force Transcendence. in action. applying multiple effects. The mood is dominating will, showing the raw power and intensity of the effect.
